targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExact(session_id) AS paid_sessions FROM telemetry_guard.tg_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND site_key = 'tg_sk_1uIiZzN3XsyoB3skHSvCyf' AND kind = 'beacon' AND attribution_channel IN ('meta_ads','tiktok_ads','google_ads','microsoft_ads','paid_other')

SELECT uniqExact(session_id) AS organic_sessions FROM telemetry_guard.tg_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND site_key = 'tg_sk_1uIiZzN3XsyoB3skHSvCyf' AND kind = 'beacon' AND attribution_channel = 'organic_search'

SELECT round(avg(duration_sec),1) AS avg_session_seconds FROM (SELECT session_id, dateDiff('second', min(timestamp), max(timestamp)) AS duration_sec FROM telemetry_guard.tg_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND site_key = 'tg_sk_1uIiZzN3XsyoB3skHSvCyf' AND kind = 'beacon' GROUP BY session_id)

panels.title: Average page views / session
panels.description: Uses the SDK's cumulative pages_viewed value, with distinct captured paths as a minimum fallback.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(avg(page_views),2) AS avg_page_views FROM (SELECT session_id, greatest(max(if(isFinite(pages_viewed), pages_viewed, 0)), toFloat64(uniqExactIf(landing_path, landing_path != ''))) AS page_views FROM telemetry_guard.tg_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND site_key = 'tg_sk_1uIiZzN3XsyoB3skHSvCyf' AND kind = 'beacon' GROUP BY session_id)

panels.title: Sessions over time by marketing source
panels.description: YouTube referrals and Google Ads are combined as YouTube / Google. Each session is counted once by its initial source.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT session_id, min(timestamp) AS first_seen, argMin(attribution_channel,timestamp) AS source, argMin(ifNull(document_referrer,''),timestamp) AS doc_ref FROM telemetry_guard.tg_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND site_key='tg_sk_1uIiZzN3XsyoB3skHSvCyf' AND kind='beacon' GROUP BY session_id) SELECT toStartOfInterval(first_seen, INTERVAL 15 MINUTE) AS time, multiIf(source='meta_ads' OR positionCaseInsensitive(doc_ref,'facebook.')>0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(doc_ref,'instagram.')>0,'Facebook / Meta',source='tiktok_ads' OR positionCaseInsensitive(doc_ref,'tiktok.')>0,'TikTok',source='google_ads' OR positionCaseInsensitive(doc_ref,'youtube.')>0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(doc_ref,'youtu.be')>0,'YouTube / Google',source='organic_search','Organic Search',source='microsoft_ads','Microsoft Ads',source='direct','Direct',source='referral','Other Referral','Other') AS source_group, count() AS sessions FROM s GROUP BY time,source_group ORDER BY time

WITH s AS (SELECT session_id,argMin(attribution_channel,timestamp) AS source,argMin(ifNull(document_referrer,''),timestamp) AS doc_ref FROM telemetry_guard.tg_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND site_key='tg_sk_1uIiZzN3XsyoB3skHSvCyf' AND kind='beacon' GROUP BY session_id) SELECT multiIf(source='meta_ads' OR positionCaseInsensitive(doc_ref,'facebook.')>0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(doc_ref,'instagram.')>0,'Facebook / Meta',source='tiktok_ads' OR positionCaseInsensitive(doc_ref,'tiktok.')>0,'TikTok',source='google_ads' OR positionCaseInsensitive(doc_ref,'youtube.')>0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(doc_ref,'youtu.be')>0,'YouTube / Google',source='organic_search','Organic Search',source='microsoft_ads','Microsoft Ads',source='direct','Direct',source='referral','Other Referral','Other') AS source_group,count() AS sessions FROM s GROUP BY source_group ORDER BY sessions DESC

panels.title: Source performance comparison
panels.description: Blocks are detected verdicts only; TelemetryGuard is currently observe-only and does not block visitors.

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT session_id,minIf(timestamp,kind='beacon') AS first_seen,maxIf(timestamp,kind='beacon') AS last_seen,argMinIf(attribution_channel,timestamp,kind='beacon') AS source,argMinIf(ifNull(document_referrer,''),timestamp,kind='beacon') AS doc_ref,greatest(maxIf(if(isFinite(pages_viewed),pages_viewed,0),kind='beacon'),toFloat64(uniqExactIf(landing_path,kind='beacon' AND landing_path!=''))) AS page_views,countIf(kind='beacon' AND beacon_integrity_ok=0)>0 AS integrity_failed,argMaxIf(band,timestamp,kind='verdict') AS verdict FROM telemetry_guard.tg_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND site_key='tg_sk_1uIiZzN3XsyoB3skHSvCyf' GROUP BY session_id), g AS (SELECT *,multiIf(source='meta_ads' OR positionCaseInsensitive(doc_ref,'facebook.')>0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(doc_ref,'instagram.')>0,'Facebook / Meta',source='tiktok_ads' OR positionCaseInsensitive(doc_ref,'tiktok.')>0,'TikTok',source='google_ads' OR positionCaseInsensitive(doc_ref,'youtube.')>0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(doc_ref,'youtu.be')>0,'YouTube / Google',source='organic_search','Organic Search',source='microsoft_ads','Microsoft Ads',source='direct','Direct',source='referral','Other Referral','Other') AS source_group FROM s) SELECT source_group,count() AS sessions,round(100*count()/sum(count()) OVER (),1) AS traffic_share_pct,round(avg(dateDiff('second',first_seen,last_seen)),1) AS avg_duration_sec,round(avg(page_views),2) AS avg_page_views,round(100*countIf(page_views<=1)/count(),1) AS bounce_pct,round(100*countIf(dateDiff('second',first_seen,last_seen)>=30 OR page_views>=2)/count(),1) AS engaged_pct,round(100*countIf(integrity_failed)/count(),1) AS integrity_failure_pct,countIf(verdict='block') AS detected_blocks FROM g GROUP BY source_group ORDER BY sessions DESC

WITH s AS (SELECT session_id,min(timestamp) AS first_seen,max(timestamp) AS last_seen,argMin(attribution_channel,timestamp) AS source,argMin(ifNull(document_referrer,''),timestamp) AS doc_ref FROM telemetry_guard.tg_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND site_key='tg_sk_1uIiZzN3XsyoB3skHSvCyf' AND kind='beacon' GROUP BY session_id) SELECT multiIf(source='meta_ads' OR positionCaseInsensitive(doc_ref,'facebook.')>0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(doc_ref,'instagram.')>0,'Facebook / Meta',source='tiktok_ads' OR positionCaseInsensitive(doc_ref,'tiktok.')>0,'TikTok',source='google_ads' OR positionCaseInsensitive(doc_ref,'youtube.')>0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(doc_ref,'youtu.be')>0,'YouTube / Google',source='organic_search','Organic Search',source='microsoft_ads','Microsoft Ads',source='direct','Direct',source='referral','Other Referral','Other') AS source_group,round(avg(dateDiff('second',first_seen,last_seen)),1) AS avg_session_seconds FROM s GROUP BY source_group ORDER BY avg_session_seconds DESC

WITH s AS (SELECT session_id,argMin(attribution_channel,timestamp) AS source,argMin(ifNull(document_referrer,''),timestamp) AS doc_ref,greatest(max(if(isFinite(pages_viewed),pages_viewed,0)),toFloat64(uniqExactIf(landing_path,landing_path!=''))) AS page_views FROM telemetry_guard.tg_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND site_key='tg_sk_1uIiZzN3XsyoB3skHSvCyf' AND kind='beacon' GROUP BY session_id) SELECT multiIf(source='meta_ads' OR positionCaseInsensitive(doc_ref,'facebook.')>0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(doc_ref,'instagram.')>0,'Facebook / Meta',source='tiktok_ads' OR positionCaseInsensitive(doc_ref,'tiktok.')>0,'TikTok',source='google_ads' OR positionCaseInsensitive(doc_ref,'youtube.')>0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(doc_ref,'youtu.be')>0,'YouTube / Google',source='organic_search','Organic Search',source='microsoft_ads','Microsoft Ads',source='direct','Direct',source='referral','Other Referral','Other') AS source_group,round(avg(page_views),2) AS avg_page_views FROM s GROUP BY source_group ORDER BY avg_page_views DESC

WITH s AS (SELECT session_id,argMin(attribution_channel,timestamp) AS source,argMin(ifNull(document_referrer,''),timestamp) AS doc_ref,argMin(if(landing_path='','/',landing_path),timestamp) AS landing_page FROM telemetry_guard.tg_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND site_key='tg_sk_1uIiZzN3XsyoB3skHSvCyf' AND kind='beacon' GROUP BY session_id) SELECT multiIf(source='meta_ads' OR positionCaseInsensitive(doc_ref,'facebook.')>0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(doc_ref,'instagram.')>0,'Facebook / Meta',source='tiktok_ads' OR positionCaseInsensitive(doc_ref,'tiktok.')>0,'TikTok',source='google_ads' OR positionCaseInsensitive(doc_ref,'youtube.')>0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(doc_ref,'youtu.be')>0,'YouTube / Google',source='organic_search','Organic Search',source='microsoft_ads','Microsoft Ads',source='direct','Direct',source='referral','Other Referral','Other') AS source_group,landing_page,count() AS sessions FROM s GROUP BY source_group,landing_page ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 30

SELECT attribution_channel AS source,if(utm_campaign='','(not tagged)',utm_campaign) AS campaign,if(ifNull(document_referrer,'')='','(not exposed)',domain(document_referrer)) AS referrer_host,uniqExact(session_id) AS sessions,round(avg(if(isFinite(time_on_page_sec),time_on_page_sec,0)),1) AS avg_time_on_page_sec FROM telemetry_guard.tg_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND site_key='tg_sk_1uIiZzN3XsyoB3skHSvCyf' AND kind='beacon' AND attribution_channel IN ('meta_ads','tiktok_ads','google_ads','microsoft_ads','paid_other','organic_search') GROUP BY source,campaign,referrer_host ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Top referring websites
panels.description: The external website recorded by the browser when the visitor first arrived. Direct/hidden includes typed URLs, bookmarks, apps, and browsers that suppress the referrer.

targets.rawSql: WITH sessions AS (SELECT session_id,min(timestamp) AS first_seen,max(timestamp) AS last_seen,argMin(attribution_channel,timestamp) AS channel,argMin(ifNull(document_referrer,''),timestamp) AS doc_ref,argMin(if(landing_path='','/',landing_path),timestamp) AS landing_page,greatest(max(if(isFinite(pages_viewed),pages_viewed,0)),toFloat64(uniqExactIf(landing_path,landing_path!=''))) AS page_views FROM telemetry_guard.tg_events WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND site_key='tg_sk_1uIiZzN3XsyoB3skHSvCyf' AND kind='beacon' GROUP BY session_id), attributed AS (SELECT *,if(doc_ref='' OR domain(doc_ref)='','(direct / hidden)',lower(replaceRegexpOne(domain(doc_ref),'^www\.',''))) AS referring_site FROM sessions) SELECT referring_site,argMin(channel,first_seen) AS channel,count() AS sessions,round(100*count()/sum(count()) OVER (),1) AS traffic_share_pct,round(avg(dateDiff('second',first_seen,last_seen)),1) AS avg_session_seconds,round(avg(page_views),2) AS avg_page_views,argMax(landing_page,first_seen) AS latest_landing_page,max(first_seen) AS latest_visit FROM attributed GROUP BY referring_site ORDER BY sessions DESC,latest_visit DESC LIMIT 50
